svg.aria-label: A log file drawn as a column of lines. A magnifying glass labelled grep for the expected keyword hovers over the lower lines and finds nothing. Two lines above the line it was hunting for, a line is circled in coral: the real failure. An arrow labelled read in order runs down the left side of the file from the top.
svg.text: grep can only confirm the theory you already have
the logs weren't useless. the search was wrong.
